name: Clipboard
description: Clipboard history with cliphist: a watcher service, a searchable panel (SUPER+CTRL+V) and a `>` launcher provider

maxItems.description: Entries cliphist keeps (cliphist -max-items); applies when the service starts

maxRows.description: Text rows visible in the panel before it scrolls

preview.description: Show the selected entry in full under the list; Ctrl+P or the eye button toggles it and writes the new value here

previewMaxBytes.description: Entries larger than this are described, never decoded; decoded text is additionally capped at 64 KiB because the pane lays it out

previewMaxPixels.description: Images with more pixels than this are described, never decoded: Qt decodes an image in full before it scales it down

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.clipboard to drive the open panel without a keyboard
